description: This file defines an Android activity (WebContentActivity) that loads and displays HTML content from the app's assets folder within a WebView. It supports D-pad navigation for Android TV and provides a static method to create intents for launching the activity with a specified HTML asset.

classes.name: WebContentActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays HTML content from assets in a WebView, with support for D-pad navigation and intent creation.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Creates an intent to launch WebContentActivity with a specified HTML asset path.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the WebView, configures settings, loads the specified HTML asset, and sets up focus behavior.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events, specifically the BACK key to close the activity and D-pad/Enter keys to allow HTML content to handle clicks.
